_how_to: names = places that show up in the phone's 'Where to?' list, with how VISTA says them. edges = one line per walk between two spots, in the direction you walk it; 'say' is spoken when the user reaches 'from' on the way to their destination. Add a reverse edge if people walk it the other way (left and right swap!).
